verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax is documented as automating "sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance on all your transactions." Tax can be calculated and collected on Payment Links without code. Tax calculations and registrations are also exposed as API/MCP-callable resources, and tax reports are available. Missing for 10: detail on jurisdiction coverage and calculation accuracy, explicit documentation of automatic tax across Checkout/Billing/Invoicing flows, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
